title: Build a word-frequency counter in Go with top-N retrieval
description: Greenfield Go task: implement a WordFrequency type that tracks word counts and returns the top N words by frequency, sorted descending by count.

required_artifacts: WordCount struct with Word string and Count int fields
Add increments the count for the given word
TopN returns at most n WordCount items sorted descending by Count
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
